name: Rafael Delgado
place: Rio de Janeiro, Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

credits.title: Funk
credits.overview: The rise of MC Sabrina, a young Brazilian funk singer, from her beginnings in Morro dos Prazeres to the electrifying favela parties that pulse through the heart of Rio de Janeiro.

credits.title: Two Halves
credits.overview: A special dinner between a young couple seems to be leaning toward a breakup, but actually conceals something darker, weirder, and oddly socially aware.

credits.title: Road To The Mouth Of Hell
credits.overview: A group of young people are returning from a trip when they find a teenage girl lost on the road and offer her a lift. After being abandoned by the driver, the group decides to spend the night at the young woman's house. They just didn't expect it to be the worst choice of their lives...

credits.title: Quatro Amigas Numa Fria
credits.overview: Dani is about to get married and travels with three other friends to Bariloche for her bachelorette party.
